settings_security_purpose: Your password, where you're signed in, keys for other apps, proxy sign-in and the sign-in cookie.
settings_security_password_signs_out: Changing it signs out every other browser signed in with the password. API keys and trusted-proxy sign-ins keep working.
settings_security_password_done: Password changed. Every other browser signed in with the password was signed out; this one stays signed in.
settings_security_sessions_help: Sign out everywhere else if you signed in on a shared or lost device. This browser stays signed in.
settings_security_sessions_dialog_body: Every other browser signed in to Lodestar is signed out. People reaching Lodestar through a trusted proxy aren't affected.
settings_security_sessions_done: Every other browser signed in with the password was signed out.
settings_security_cookies_help: With secure cookies on, the browser sends the sign-in cookie only over HTTPS. Turn them on when you reach Lodestar through HTTPS (a reverse proxy with a certificate); leave them off on plain HTTP, or nobody can sign in.
settings_security_cookies_env: Set by {env}. Change it there and restart Lodestar.
settings_security_cookies_file: Set with LODESTAR_SECURE_COOKIES or http.secure_cookies in config.toml, then restart. It can't be changed here.
settings_security_cookies_unknown: Couldn't read the secure cookies setting.
settings_security_confirm_help: Lodestar asks for it every time, and doesn't keep it.
settings_security_leave_body: What you typed in {section} will be cleared.
settings_security_part_failed: This part of the screen didn't load.
settings_security_keys_help: An API key lets another app (Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, a script) search Lodestar. A feed token lets a feed reader or torrent client read your feeds. Give each app its own, so you can revoke one without breaking the others.
settings_security_keys_kind_api_help: API key: for apps that search Lodestar
settings_security_keys_kind_feed_help: Feed token: reads every feed, nothing else
settings_security_keys_name_help: Say which app uses it, like Sonarr.
settings_security_keys_create_body: Its secret is shown once, right after. Lodestar keeps only a hash of it.
settings_security_keys_regenerate_body: The old secret stops working now. Every app that uses it needs the new one.
settings_security_keys_regenerated: Regenerated {name}. The old secret no longer works.
settings_security_keys_revoke_body: It stops working now and stays listed as revoked. This can't be undone: create a new one if you need it again.
settings_security_reveal_body: This is the only time Lodestar shows it. Paste it into the app now, or keep it in a password manager. If you lose it, regenerate the key.
settings_security_reveal_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
settings_security_proxy_what: If a reverse proxy signs people in for you (Authelia, Authentik and the like), it can tell Lodestar who is signed in with a header such as Remote-User. Lodestar believes that header only from the addresses you trust here.
settings_security_proxy_recommend: Anything at a trusted address can sign in as anyone, without a password. Recommended: leave this off unless you use such a proxy.
settings_security_proxy_safe_port: Don't publish Lodestar's port, or bind it to 127.0.0.1, so only the proxy can reach it.
settings_security_proxy_safe_ip: Give the proxy a fixed IP address on a user-defined Docker network, and trust exactly that address.
settings_security_proxy_safe_gateway: Never trust the Docker bridge gateway (such as 172.17.0.1) on its own: visitors from outside can arrive from it.
settings_security_proxy_failed: Couldn't read the trusted proxy settings.
settings_security_proxy_forced: Off for now: set by LODESTAR_PROXY_AUTH=off
settings_security_proxy_forced_help: The variable turns trusted proxy sign-in off until it's removed and Lodestar restarts. The switch below shows the saved setting; you can still change the addresses, header and users.
settings_security_proxy_enabled: Sign people in from the proxy's header
settings_security_proxy_enabled_saved: Saved setting: sign people in from the proxy's header
settings_security_proxy_warn: Once saved, anything at a trusted address can sign in as any allowed user, without a password.
settings_security_proxy_trusted_help: One IP address or CIDR range per line, at most 64. Needed to turn it on.
settings_security_proxy_header_help: The header the proxy puts the user name in. Empty: Remote-User.
settings_security_proxy_users_help: One name per line, at most 64. Empty: anyone the proxy names.
settings_security_proxy_save_body: Lodestar asks for your password before changing who can sign in.
settings_security_proxy_widen_title: Let more people sign in through the proxy?
settings_security_proxy_on_body: Anything at {trusted} will be able to sign in as any allowed user, without a password.
